description: Parent progress/status aggregation over a four-chunk parallel download, exercising several rules at once: progress is averaged over the full chunk count even when only some chunks have advanced; a per-chunk status event reports the derived parent status only when it differs from the previously reported one (dedup); failed takes precedence over not-found which takes precedence over not-yet-complete; and 'complete' is reported only once every chunk has completed. Only ONE chunk_aggregate case can appear in this file because the parallel-download isolate stores the parent task in single-assignment (late final) global state, so a second case in the same process would throw and surface as error=unhandled. The output records the value derived after each event.

cases.expected_output:
parent_progress=0.0
parent_progress=0.0625
parent_progress=0.25
parent_progress=0.25
parent_status=none
status_change=none
status_change=notFound
status_change=failed
status_change=none
status_change=none
status_change=complete
parent_progress=0.25
parent_status=complete
